title: Unique Disability ID (UDID)
content: An Indian citizen with any of the 21 disabilities recognized under the RPwD Act, 2016 can apply. A legal guardian may apply for a minor or a person who cannot apply themselves because of disability.

title: Unique Disability ID (UDID)
content: The official UDID information lists a passport photograph, signature or thumbprint, identity proof and relevant medical records as required documents.

title: Unique Disability ID (UDID)
content: Applicants can register and apply online through the UDID portal. An offline alternative is also available through designated hospitals.

title: Unique Disability ID (UDID)
content: Applicants can track the application status through the official UDID portal using an Enrollment Number, UDID Number, Aadhaar Number or registered mobile number.

title: Unique Disability ID (UDID)
content: UDID provides a centralized disability identification and certification system and supports access to government schemes and benefits.
